# DORMIED

> DORMIED is an independent golf brand intelligence platform. We track search interest for 169 golf brands across 11 global markets, updated monthly. No endorsements, no opinions — just data.

## What We Do

DORMIED publishes the DORMIED Index (DI) — a monthly ranking of golf brands by real search demand across the US, UK, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, China, Germany, France, Sweden, and globally. A brand's DI Score is its search volume relative to the top brand in a given period (100 = most searched). Rankings update monthly.

We cover every major segment of golf: equipment, apparel, footwear, accessories, tech and training aids, balls, shafts and grips, and lifestyle brands.

## Pages

- Homepage / Index: https://dormied.com/ — Monthly match-ups, top movers, brand scorecard, latest news
- Rankings: https://dormied.com/rankings/ — Full 169-brand index table, sortable by 11 markets
- Brand Directory: https://dormied.com/brands/ — Browse all 169 brands by category
- News Feed: https://dormied.com/news/ — Golf brand coverage aggregated from top publications, tagged by brand
- Match-Ups: https://dormied.com/matchups/ — Daily head-to-head brand comparisons, data-driven
- About: https://dormied.com/about/ — Editorial mission, methodology, team
- Privacy Policy: https://dormied.com/privacy/

## Brand Pages

Each brand has a dedicated page at https://dormied.com/brands/[slug]/ with:
- Current global rank and DI Score
- Monthly trend chart (12+ months of data)
- Rankings across all 11 markets
- AI-generated editorial take on current momentum ("The Read")
- Latest news coverage for that brand

## Data Methodology

The DORMIED Index uses Google Trends search interest data as a proxy for brand relevance and consumer attention. Data is normalised so the top brand in each period = 100. Rankings are updated monthly, typically in the first week of the following month.

Markets tracked: Global, United States, United Kingdom, Japan, South Korea, Canada, Australia, China, Germany, France, Sweden.
